name: GeoQuizle 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: GeoQuizle is a collection of geography and photography guessing games that let you unleash your inner explorer. There are four game modes you can play:Flagle: Guess the country in 6 tries or less based on its flag, with bonus trivia after each roundStatele: Identify U.S.
